status_note_zh: 概念级构件清单，不构成工程做法、设备选型或采购清单；法定数值待控规与专项设计确认。
status_note_en: Concept-grade list, not a specification, equipment schedule or procurement list.

components.name_zh: 透水铺装与导盲连续带
components.name_en: Permeable paving + continuous tactile guide strip
components.where_applied_zh: 主脊绿道全线、三处重点区站前广场、街坊间横街
components.range_zh: 步道有效宽度 ≥3.0 m（主脊）/ ≥2.0 m（横街）；透水率 ≥1×10-4 m/s；导盲带连续断点 ≤5 m
components.range_en: Clear width ≥3.0 m spine / ≥2.0 m cross-street; permeability ≥1e-4 m/s; guide-strip gaps ≤5 m
components.accessibility_zh: 无高差或设 ≤1:20 坡道；导盲带与提示块按无障碍法双色对比；轮椅回转直径 ≥1.5 m 每 200 m 一处
components.accessibility_en: Level or ≤1:20 ramps; two-contrast tactile paving; ≥1.5 m turning circle every 200 m
components.data_power_zh: 无源构件，不需数据与供电
components.maintenance_zh: 区市政环卫（清扫）＋ 园林（铺装沉降年度巡检）
components.maintenance_en: District sanitation + parks authority annual settlement survey
components.status_zh: 概念级构件，不构成工程做法或采购清单
components.status_en: Concept-grade, not a specification or procurement list

components.where_applied_zh: 主脊每 150–250 m、地标节点、轨道站出入口 50 m 内
components.where_applied_en: Every 150–250 m on the spine, landmark nodes, within 50 m of station exits
components.range_zh: 每处 2–6 座；其中 ≥30% 带靠背与扶手；遮荫服务半径 ≤15 m；冬季设避风面
components.range_en: 2–6 seats per cluster; ≥30% with back and arm rest; shade within 15 m; wind-sheltered face in winter
components.accessibility_zh: 座高 430–460 mm、单侧扶手便于起身；相邻 900 mm 留出轮椅位且不占用通行净宽
components.accessibility_en: Seat height 430–460 mm with transfer-side armrest; 900 mm adjacent wheelchair space outside the clear path
components.data_power_zh: 可选占用传感（LoRa，1 W 级），默认不装
components.data_power_en: Optional occupancy sensing (LoRa, ~1 W), off by default
components.maintenance_zh: 属地街道/重点区运营主体，月度巡检，木构件年度翻新
components.maintenance_en: Street office / key-area operator; monthly inspection, annual timber refresh
components.status_zh: 数量由 294 街坊几何与主脊长度派生，为设计建议值
components.status_en: Counts derived from the 294-parcel geometry and spine length; design suggestion

components.name_zh: 无障碍与触觉语音双通道导视
components.where_applied_zh: 全线导视：站点—道岔—里程命名体系，三处重点区出入口与地标
components.where_applied_en: Corridor-wide signage in the station–switch–kilometre naming system
components.range_zh: 字符高度按 1:200 视距（3 m 读距 ≥15 mm）；臂展可达范围内设置；信标间距 ≤30 m
components.range_en: Character height 1:200 (≥15 mm at 3 m); within reach range; beacons ≤30 m apart
components.accessibility_zh: 触觉＋语音＋高对比视觉三通道并存；任一 AI 导览均有纯离线人工查询替代
components.accessibility_en: Tactile + voice + high-contrast visual; every AI guide has an offline human fallback
components.data_power_zh: 蓝牙/AI 信标需 POI 数据与市政电（单点 ≤15 W），断网时降级为静态图
components.data_power_en: BLE/AI beacons need POI data and mains power (≤15 W), degrade to static map when offline
components.maintenance_zh: 运营主体维护内容，数据由区级开放数据平台版本化发布
components.maintenance_en: Operator maintains content; data versioned on the district open-data platform
components.status_zh: 命名体系见正文文化叙事节；不含具体品牌商标
components.status_en: Naming system in the narrative section; no trademark claimed

components.where_applied_zh: 主脊与三处重点区交叉口、广场边缘；避免在居住侧 25 m 内布设
components.where_applied_en: Intersections and plaza edges; not within 25 m of residential faces
components.range_zh: 杆高 6–8 m；单杆合灯/传感/屏/微基站 ≤4 类设备；屏体面积 ≤1.2 m2 且夜间 22:00–07:00 关闭
components.range_en: 6–8 m tall; ≤4 device classes per pole; screen ≤1.2 m2, off 22:00–07:00
components.accessibility_zh: 杆体不得侵入 2.5 m 净宽；底座高差做斜坡过渡并加触觉提示
components.accessibility_en: Must not intrude on the 2.5 m clear width; sloped base with tactile warning
components.data_power_zh: 需供电（单杆 ≤350 W）与管道通信；数据仅采集非识别性人流计数，禁用人脸
components.data_power_en: Power (≤350 W) and ducted comms; non-identifying people counts only, no facial data
components.maintenance_zh: 由区市政设施统一权属，运营主体使用；故障响应 48 h
components.maintenance_en: Owned by district utilities, used by the operator; 48 h fault response
components.status_zh: 设备清单为概念配置，须待管位与负荷实测
components.status_en: Concept configuration pending duct and load surveys

components.name_zh: 贡献铭牌（数据集/模型卡/评测结果）
components.where_applied_zh: 全部朝圣地标与荣誉展示节点，每处一块
components.range_zh: 版面 600×900 mm；二维码指向包内可复算数据；每季度更新
components.range_en: 600×900 mm face; QR resolves to reproducible package data; quarterly refresh
components.accessibility_zh: 文字带盲文与语音扫码；铭牌中心高 1.2–1.4 m
components.accessibility_en: Braille and voice-readable QR; centre height 1.2–1.4 m
components.data_power_zh: 需数据管道与年度审计，无强制供电（反光/蓄光版面）
components.data_power_en: Needs a data pipeline and annual audit; no mandatory power
components.maintenance_zh: 发布主体＝入驻团队，复核主体＝区平台＋第三方评测，撤回机制见实施政策
components.maintenance_en: Issuer = tenant team; reviewer = district platform plus third-party evaluation; withdrawal rules in policy section
components.status_zh: 仅登记可核查证据，禁止合成结果冒充实测
components.status_en: Verifiable evidence only; synthetic results may not be presented as measured

components.name_zh: 夜间照明与星空友好界面
components.where_applied_zh: 主脊、绿脊节点、文物邻近段
components.range_zh: 步道维持 10–20 lx（文物段 ≤10 lx）；上射光通比 0%；色温 ≤3000 K
components.range_en: 10–20 lx path (≤10 lx at heritage), 0% uplight, ≤3000 K
components.accessibility_zh: 连续无暗区，界面亮度对比 ≤1:5；不设置频闪与投影干扰
components.accessibility_en: Continuous, no dark pockets, ≤1:5 adaptation contrast; no strobe or projection glare
components.data_power_zh: 需分回路供电与照度自检；可选人感调光（≤10 W）
components.data_power_en: Separate circuits with illuminance self-check; optional occupancy dimming (≤10 W)
components.maintenance_zh: 区路灯管理单位负责，运营主体负责景观补充照明
components.maintenance_en: District street-lighting authority plus operator for feature lighting
components.status_zh: 数值为设计目标，须经实测复核

components.where_applied_zh: 重点区后勤廊道、绿道货运支线、中试共享工厂出入口
components.where_applied_en: Key-area service corridors, greenway service branches, pilot-plant entrances
components.range_zh: 专用道净宽 ≥2.0 m；混合段限速 ≤15 km/h；行人优先时段 07:00–09:00 与 17:00–19:00 禁行
components.range_en: ≥2.0 m dedicated width; ≤15 km/h in mixed sections; no-entry 07:00–09:00 and 17:00–19:00
components.accessibility_zh: 不得占用导盲带与轮椅净宽；边界以触觉凸条与色彩双重提示
components.accessibility_en: Must not occupy tactile strips or wheelchair width; edge marked by both tactile ridge and colour
components.data_power_zh: 需车端定位与路侧单元；数据留存 ≤30 天，不采集乘员身份
components.data_power_en: Needs vehicle positioning and RSU; data retained ≤30 days, no occupant identity
components.maintenance_zh: 运营主体排班，交巡警与交通部门核定路权（本包不做路权结论）
components.maintenance_en: Operator schedules; right-of-way to be determined by traffic authority (not claimed here)
components.status_zh: 路权与法规适配是外部依赖，属未决条件
components.status_en: Right-of-way and regulatory fit is an unresolved external dependency

components.name_zh: 遮荫微气候与饮水卫生单元
components.where_applied_zh: 广场、绿脊开敞段、儿童与老年活动点 50 m 内
components.where_applied_en: Plazas, green-ridge openings, within 50 m of children's and seniors' activity spots
components.range_zh: 夏季遮荫覆盖 ≥60% 停留面；每处饮水器服务半径 ≤300 m；雾森仅在高湿度阈值以下启动
components.range_en: ≥60% shade coverage of dwell areas in summer; water point within 300 m; misting only below a humidity threshold
components.accessibility_zh: 出水高度 750–850 mm 并设轮椅让位区；把手防烫与防滑
components.accessibility_en: Spout at 750–850 mm with wheelchair clearance; anti-scald, non-slip
components.data_power_zh: 需给排水与季度水质检测记录；用电 ≤60 W
components.data_power_en: Needs water supply/drainage and quarterly water-quality records; ≤60 W
components.maintenance_zh: 属地环卫＋ 卫健抽检；冬季排空防冻
components.maintenance_en: Street sanitation plus health sampling; winter drain-down
components.status_zh: 以人体感受与卫生合规为约束，不以降温能耗为目标
components.status_en: Driven by comfort and hygiene, not cooling-energy targets
